name: librarian
description: Curates, catalogs, retrieves, and maintains your library of notes and knowledge in an Obsidian vault. Workflow-shaped (Capture / Process / Retrieve / Maintain) and agent-mediated (skills draft, agents execute). 18 skills + 4 agents + 6 references, coupled to the vault conventions in ~/Loose Ends/.claude/rules/{wiki.md,catalog.md} and the Templater templates in ~/Loose Ends/Templates/.

interface.longDescription: Capture, process, retrieve, and maintain notes through approval-gated workflows and isolated vault roles.
defaultPrompt: Search my knowledge base for this topic.
Capture this as a structured note.
Inspect my vault without changing anything.
